# nb-studio service

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs from the API document. Do not edit: change the route’s describeRoute() or x-cli, then run `node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs`. -->

## service check

Check a model over a connection

Asks a model for a short answer (an embedding, a ranking) over a connection being edited, or a saved service's. Needs `agents.services` manage. A model that does not answer is `ok: false` with the reason, not an error.

```bash
nb-studio service check --model <string>
```

| Flag           | Type                                                                                                        | Description                                       |
| -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `--service`    | string                                                                                                      | The configured model service name.                |
| `--provider`   | openai \| anthropic \| google \| deepseek \| alibaba \| moonshotai \| ollama \| cohere \| openai-compatible | The provider implementation to use.               |
| `--base-url`   | string                                                                                                      | The provider’s API base URL.                      |
| `--api-key`    | string                                                                                                      | The provider API key.                             |
| `--model`      | string                                                                                                      | The provider’s model identifier. (required)       |
| `--kind`       | chat \| embedding \| rerank                                                                                 | The model capability: chat, embedding, or rerank. |
| `--dimensions` | integer                                                                                                     | The embedding vector dimensions.                  |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agents/checkConnection` (`agentsCheckConnection`)

## service create

Create a model service

Needs `agents.services` manage. The key is stored encrypted and never answered.

```bash
nb-studio service create
```

| Flag         | Type                                                                                                        | Description                                                       |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--title`    | string                                                                                                      | The display title.                                                |
| `--provider` | openai \| anthropic \| google \| deepseek \| alibaba \| moonshotai \| ollama \| cohere \| openai-compatible | The provider implementation to use.                               |
| `--base-url` | string                                                                                                      | The provider’s API base URL.                                      |
| `--api-key`  | string                                                                                                      | The provider API key.                                             |
| `--models`   | json                                                                                                        | The models this service offers.                                   |
| `--enabled`  | boolean                                                                                                     | Whether the service is enabled.                                   |
| `--file`     | path                                                                                                        | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agents/services` (`agentsCreateModelService`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio service create --title OpenAI --provider openai
```

## service delete

Delete a model service

Needs `agents.services` manage.

```bash
nb-studio service delete <service>
```

| Argument  | Description                        |
| --------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `service` | The configured model service name. |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                                                          |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Delete this model service? Agents using it stop answering.” |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `DELETE /api/agents/services/{serviceName}` (`agentsDeleteModelService`)

## service discover

Discover the models a provider lists

Asks the provider for its models over a connection being edited, or a saved service's (`service`), whose stored key is used when none is given. Needs `agents.services` manage. A provider that cannot be reached is `ok: false` with the reason, not an error.

```bash
nb-studio service discover
```

| Flag         | Type                                                                                                        | Description                         |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `--service`  | string                                                                                                      | The configured model service name.  |
| `--provider` | openai \| anthropic \| google \| deepseek \| alibaba \| moonshotai \| ollama \| cohere \| openai-compatible | The provider implementation to use. |
| `--base-url` | string                                                                                                      | The provider’s API base URL.        |
| `--api-key`  | string                                                                                                      | The provider API key.               |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agents/discoverModels` (`agentsDiscoverModels`)

## service list

List model services

Needs `agents.services` read. Keys are never answered, only whether one is set.

```bash
nb-studio service list
```

**Output:** A list (table columns: `name`, `title`, `provider`, `enabled`, `apiKeySet`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/agents/services` (`agentsListModelServices`)

## service update

Update a model service

Needs `agents.services` manage. An omitted key keeps the stored one; `null` removes it.

```bash
nb-studio service update <service>
```

| Argument  | Description                        |
| --------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `service` | The configured model service name. |

| Flag         | Type    | Description                                                       |
| ------------ | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--title`    | string  | The display title.                                                |
| `--base-url` | string  | The provider’s API base URL.                                      |
| `--api-key`  | string  | The provider API key.                                             |
| `--models`   | json    | The models this service offers.                                   |
| `--enabled`  | boolean | Whether the service is enabled.                                   |
| `--file`     | path    | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `PATCH /api/agents/services/{serviceName}` (`agentsUpdateModelService`)
